rule: Q-40: tau_s = 4th smallest fidelity, tau_t = 4th smallest consistency, tau_d = 4th largest deviation, tau_b = 4th largest uncertainty over the 40 calibration worlds, duplicates included, exact fractions; main tau at (alpha0 = 0.7, k = 0); I-6 at (alpha0, k0 = 5); I-7: D1 (min / max) on the first 10 worlds at k = 0; I-8: D1 on the first 10 worlds at (alpha0, k0 = 5); alt: Q-40 at (alpha0, 0) on each alternative set (null for a set that did not reach 40 valid worlds within 200 draws)
